---
title: Media Transformations binding for Workers
description: Transform videos directly in Workers without requiring public URL access to source files.
products:
  - stream
date: 2026-03-18
---

import { WranglerConfig, TypeScriptExample } from "~/components";

You can now use a Workers binding to transform videos with Media Transformations.

To get started, add the Media binding to your Wrangler configuration:

<WranglerConfig>

```toml
[media]
binding = "MEDIA"
```

</WranglerConfig>

Then use the binding in your Worker to transform videos:

<TypeScriptExample>

```ts
export default {
	async fetch(request, env) {
		const video = await env.R2_BUCKET.get("input.mp4");
		return env.MEDIA.input(video.body).output({ mode: "video" }).response();
	},
};
```

</TypeScriptExample>
